method: Vendor and reseller pages fetched 2026-10-25. EUR converted at 1 EUR = 1.1193 USD (ECB 2026-10-23); original EUR prices are in stock_note. in_stock=true means at least one seller shows the item in stock or orderable now; unit counts are rarely shown. lead_time_days is the stated ship/delivery upper bound for the best in-stock source, null if not stated. volts_ok_60v uses the manufacturer's stated max voltage; null = max not stated. Shopify 'available' flags alone were not treated as in stock (backorders allowed). RobotShop search, Foxtech, AliExpress and some rcdrone/aifitlab pages blocked automated access.
